title: Design Day Bangalore — Women Entrepreneurs in Design
description:
The theme for May's 2015's Design Day is: Women Entrepreneurs in Design.

Design Day is a curated platform for Designers to meet, discuss & solve problems together.

The agenda includes:

10:00 - Welcome Note
10:10 - Introduction to Design Day
10:20 - Intrapreneurship in Corporates - Ronita De, UX Lead, Honeywell
10:40 - Intrapreneurship in Startups - Nidhi Srikanth, Design Lead, Pink Lemonade
11:00 - The Daily Dump Story - Poonam Bir Kasturi, Founder & CEO
11:20 - The Daamak Jwelry Story - Vidhi Chandak, Founder & CEO

Cheers,

Team Design Day
